rules: All unresolved inputs used by a selected operation must have a supplied qualified value and provenance before that operation starts
An authored substitute for unread video choreography must be labeled authored and qualified, not source recovered
Do not expand to an infinite continuous angle sweep; provide a finite condition list
Array source angle list is seven explicit settings for each loading class
Required versus optional branches and one-family versus whole-campaign goal must be visible
Reading a nominal sensor range does not establish actual safe load limits
No default executable motion, printer settings, torque thresholds or timing is supplied by this package
